details: Citigroup is reportedly planning to offer tokenized shares of private companies to its wealthy and institutional clients. This move signifies increasing institutional adoption of blockchain technology for traditional assets, aiming to enhance efficiency and accessibility in private markets.
title: Citigroup to Offer Tokenized Shares for Institutional Clients

details: Binance has launched bStocks, tokenized securities backed 1:1 by US shares held at a regulated custodian, allowing 24/7 trading on the spot market. These bStocks can be converted instantly with no fees and support withdrawals to compatible BNB Smart Chain wallets, integrating traditional finance with DeFi.
title: Binance Introduces bStocks, Tokenized US Stocks Tradable 24/7

details: The U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) has charged two individuals in connection with a $389 million crypto laundering case involving a scheme named "AudiA6." This action underscores ongoing efforts by authorities to combat illicit activities within the cryptocurrency space.
title: DOJ Charges Two in $389 Million Crypto Laundering Case

details: MicroStrategy, a prominent corporate holder of Bitcoin, purchased an additional 1,550 BTC for $101.3 million between June 1 and 7. This acquisition comes after a rare sale a week prior, indicating continued conviction in Bitcoin as a treasury reserve asset.
title: MicroStrategy Buys 1,550 BTC for $101 Million

details: Hungary is reportedly planning to scrap crypto trading penalties after a crackdown in 2025, moving towards decriminalizing cryptocurrency trading. This regulatory shift could create a more favorable environment for crypto activities in the country.
title: Hungary Plans to Decriminalize Crypto Trading Post-2025

details: UK funds could soon gain the ability to add crypto Exchange-Traded Notes (ETNs) to their portfolios, although the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) is expected to maintain a 10% exposure limit. This development would broaden institutional access to crypto assets in the UK.
title: UK Funds May Soon Add Crypto ETNs with 10% Exposure Cap

details: U.S. Bitcoin spot ETFs experienced $214 million in net outflows on Wednesday, led by iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT). This cooling demand, coupled with persistent macroeconomic headwinds like US-Iran tensions and sticky inflation, contributes to a tighter liquidity environment for crypto markets.
title: Bitcoin ETFs See Recent Outflows, Macro Headwinds Persist

details: Tether, the issuer of the largest stablecoin USDT, led a significant $1.4 billion funding round for NEURA Robotics. This investment highlights increasing interest and capital flow from the crypto industry into advanced technology sectors like AI and robotics, potentially integrating crypto wallets into future machines.
title: Tether Leads $1.4 Billion Funding Round for NEURA Robotics
